minimum_parity_collision.form: two copies of one exact component type are replaced by two copies of another while the complete odd-multiplicity component set stays unchanged

findings.statement: On predeclared fresh non-affine 4x5-k4, exact-rank degree-2 GF(2)^2 valuation over exact component-parity variables leaves 12 contradictions.
Adding all observed square-free exact-component cubic monomials adds 8,486 columns and 70 rank directions but leaves the same 12 contradictions, including the same first contradiction.

There are three exact-rank T2-O classes on 4x5-k4 with identical complete exact-component multiplicity-parity vectors but different scalar values. Therefore no evaluator depending only on exact rank and those binary parity coordinates can be Q-V exact, regardless of polynomial degree.
Full exact component multiplicity remains Q-V exact on 4x5-k4, isolating the fresh failure to count reduction rather than to the exact component multiset representation.
Exact-rank component multiplicities modulo 3, 4, and 6 are each Q-V exact on the complete 4x5-k4 T2-O corpus.

superseded_or_narrowed: The prior hypothesis that quadratic degree may be generally sufficient is now falsified by 4x5-k4.
The prior plan to seek two final syndrome bits solely over multiplicity-parity component coordinates is too narrow for 4x5-k4.
TOPO_RPAR remains a valid scalar-exact coordinate on the earlier demanding carriers but fails fresh 4x5-k4 together with the broader REL_INC degree-2 model.
nonclaims: Degree 3 is not claimed universally insufficient outside the frozen parity coordinate.
Modulo 3, 4, or 6 is not claimed to be the universal final count algebra.
Full component multiplicity is not claimed minimal.
next_question: What is the smallest outcome-independent refinement of component multiplicity parity that retains the pair-count information needed on 4x5-k4 while preserving the earlier bounded exactness results?
